## bdcb4c9eb6bd

**Concrete validator/canonical-domain defect reproduced.** Generator SHA-256
`acf88b5cb5aee7e524a4cec4dcafb43d75a2d8356c2671ddc00b2297cb02e755`
imposes a one-cell border margin that the canonical task does not require.
`self_check` rejects official canonical training inputs 1 and 2; for training
input 1 it returns `rectangle lacks the required one-cell border margin`.
The supported Racket `apply` command executes rule hash `c507f6de75fe` on that
same input and exactly reproduces the canonical output. The complete,
hash-bound witness is `checks/audit/bdcb4c9eb6bd/counterexample.json`, with the
input and Racket receipt beside it.

The full unchanged-target battery independently failed 7/12 stages: lint,
selfcheck, defect lint, profile floor, semantic gate, override and authority
sync. It also found 0/60 exact canonical-profile draws, no declared semantic
contract, more than 63,000 override findings, no `RULE_HASH` pin, and divergent
active authority text. Evidence: `checks/audit/bdcb4c9eb6bd-battery/`. This is an
audit-only finding; no source or authority file for `bdcb4c9eb6bd` was edited.
